name: MYHM Puzzling in Plano 2023
information: This competition is supported by [CubingUSA](https://cubingusa.org/). - Please review the [competitor information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PuzzlinginPlano2023#27613-competitor-information) tab before the competition. - Please review the other tabs for more information on the competition. Please note that the [schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PuzzlinginPlano2023#competition-schedule) is subject to change, as we may hold events slightly earlier or later than shown depending on whether the competition is running ahead of schedule or behind schedule. Special thanks to [MoYu](http://moyucube.com/en/) for sponsoring this competition! Check out the [sponsor](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PuzzlinginPlano2023#27614-sponsor) tab for more information. 3x3 Finals will be done head to head if time permits.
